note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #16, Q4 2025 Government Performance; exports mexico_2025_q4safety_govperformance.csv from mexico_safety_4q2025.dta, built from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1225.csv imported case(lower), id = _n within the quarter) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a, bp3_3, bp3_4, bp3_5, bp3_6 and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); the bookmark is identical to Q4 2024's #33 apart from input dataset and output name (diffed), and its keep list equals Q2 2025's #7. Recodes (shared block, l.192-208): bp3_2, bp3_2a, bp3_3-bp3_6 9 -> missing; bp3_1_* have no missing codes. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own 2025 Q4 data dictionary (1225) labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_1_16 '...: Ninguno'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_3 'Realizacion de tramite, pago o solicitud de forma directa ante un(a) servidor(a) publico(a) o empleado(a) de gobierno'; BP3_5 'Contacto directo con autoridades de seguridad publica (transito, municipales, estatales u otras)'; BP3_6 'Practica de corrupcion experimentada: ... por parte de policias de transito, municipales, estatales u otra autoridad de seguridad publica'); 23/23 agree in content with the Q4 2025 questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a; 3.3-3.6). Step 3b, shape (checked, not assumed): 2025 Q4 is the Q2/Q4 shape -- the trim4 print carries CP3 and 3.3-3.6 on p.5 (3.1-3.2a on p.4) before Seccion IV. Acoso (p.6); the 1225 diccionario (54 BP3_* rows), 23 catalogos/bp3_*.csv, raw CSV, .do Bookmark #16 and live table all carry the same 23 items. Step 3b, 2025 Q4 vs 2025 Q2 (batch_694): no wording change. A word-multiset diff of the Section III text layer (pdftotext pp.4-6, footer, dot leaders and underscores stripped) leaves nothing in Q2 that is not in Q4; the only Q4-side surplus is the 3.6 stem, which pdftotext places after the SECCION IV heading in the Q2 file (found there, identical). The 1225 BP3_* diccionario rows equal 0625's in content (the only byte difference is LONGITUD quoted "1" vs 1) and all 23 catalogos/bp3_*.csv are byte-identical to 0625's. Step 3b, 2025 Q4 vs 2025 Q3 (batch_698): 3.1-3.2a identical (the Q3 text layer's words are a subset of Q4's apart from the next section's heading); Q3 has no CP3/3.3-3.6 and ends Section III at 3.2a. Step 3b, 2025 Q4 vs 2024 Q4 (batch_686): two print changes, both shipped as printed in 2025 Q4 and both already in 2025 Q2: (a) CP3 rewritten -- 2024 Q4 'Tome en cuenta que una persona servidora publica o empleada de gobierno puede ser un(a) policia, personas que distribuyen apoyos de programas sociales ... Es decir, aquellas personas que trabajan en instituciones publicas.' -> 2025 Q4 'Considere que las personas servidoras publicas o empleadas de gobierno son aquellas que trabajan en instituciones publicas. Por ejemplo: una policia, un juez, un medico o doctora, secretarias o personal administrativo de escuelas publicas, de hospitales, personal de limpia y recoleccion de basura, etcetera.' (p.5); (b) 3.3 and 3.4 'un(a) servidor(a)' -> 'un (una) servidor(a)' (p.5). Both confirmed on a 110-dpi render of p.5. All other Section III wording identical to 2024 Q4 (dot-leader spacing only). Diccionario 1225 vs 1224: BP3_1_99 'No sabe/no responde' (1224 'No sabe/ no responde') and BP3_6 '...u otra autoridad de seguridad publica' (1224 '...u otras autoridades...'); labels only, not shipped text. All 31 distinct printed Spanish strings shipped (3.1 stem, 17 options, 3.2-3.6 stems, CP3, printed options Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo, Si/No) are found in the trim4 text layer after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation; the 32nd string ('No se declaro como opcion afirmativa') is the catalogo label, not print. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 48 live item x level counts (server-side GROUP BY item,resp, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q4 CSV after the .do's recodes, 48/48 (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 8916/15007, bp3_1_10 0/1 = 3679/20244, bp3_1_16 0/1 = 23451/472, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 23900/23, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 826/6357/9959/6170, bp3_2a 1/2 = 8197/15186, bp3_3 1/2 = 7144/16761, bp3_4 1/2 = 687/6453, bp3_5 1/2 = 3299/20607, bp3_6 1/2 = 1460/1839); raw 23923 rows (PER=0425 on every row, INEGI template quirk as in 1225's siblings) = 23923 live ids; live COUNT(*) 511636 = 17x23923 + 23312 + 23383 + 23905 + 7140 + 23906 + 3299; no missing resp, no duplicate id x item -- not truncated. Code 9 set missing by the .do: bp3_2 116, bp3_2a 540, bp3_3 18, bp3_4 4, bp3_5 17, bp3_6 0. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 blank in raw for 495 = 472 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 23 (bp3_1_99), exactly the respondents with either code, per 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'; bp3_4 non-blank for exactly the 7144 bp3_3=Si (0 mismatches; 'PASE A 3.5' for No/NS); bp3_6 non-blank for exactly the 3299 bp3_5=Si (0 mismatches; 'PASE A CP4'). Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered 2025 Q4 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, '(a)' gender fills, 'un (una)', 'etcetera)' in 12. Normalised: double space in 06 'limpia y  recoleccion' collapsed (as all precedents); line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; skip instructions PASE A 3.2a / 3.5 / CP4). Tarjeta C is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure (same as batch_686/694): section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a, _4 = 3.3+3.4 (CP3 read-aloud definition in section_prompt), _5 = 3.5, _6 = 3.6; instructions blank -- Section III has no whole-section introduction. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo; bp3_2a, bp3_3-bp3_6 1/2 = Si/No -- printed and identical in the 1225 catalogos; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (48/48 live item x resp cells). The shipped file is batch_694's (2025 Q2) with only table, section_id and instrument ('segundo' -> 'cuarto trimestre') changed -- diff after that substitution is empty. Step 3b table check: live items match this question block exactly (23 = 17 + 1 + 1 + 4); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance, Q4 2025') overstates it -- nothing asks about the federal government; the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q4 (diciembre 2025, file suffix 1225) wave -- same defect as the siblings. INEGI-side cosmetic label defects, no effect on shipped text: BP3_1_09 label has a double space after the colon; BP3_4 label ends '...de algun beneficio ' (trailing space, and unlike BP3_6 never names who); BP3_3 label still reads 'un(a)' while the print now reads 'un (una)'. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_694 (2025 Q2) for every field -- the Spanish is identical string for string; batch_694 itself reused batch_690 (3.1-3.2a) and batch_686 (3.3-3.6) and translated only the rewritten CP3 fresh. Nothing translated fresh here. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. table_context.R was NOT run as-is (it calls irw_fetch, a whole-table export); the batch_702 scratch copy that swaps that call for irw_table_sets() ran the dictionary/index-status sections unchanged (no STOP; not in Sheet1 or any cross-check tab).
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, cuarto trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.6) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
